# The appointments Sarutahiko made — and who is keeping them

One myth is a story. A cycle of myths is a specification. Read Sarutahiko's cycle in order and the industries fall out of it one by one.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Sarutahiko
- **Pantheon:** Japanese
- **Domain of influence:** Crossroads, Guidance
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Commerce & Governance · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Communication, Messaging & Logistics
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 426 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Communication, Messaging & Logistics — through *The Blockade at the Heavenly Bridge*

When Ninigi prepared to descend from heaven, the earthly kami Sarutahiko stood at the Floating Bridge of Heaven and refused passage.  None of the heavenly envoys could persuade him.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The long-nosed kami of crossroads and guidance who shows the way at every fork.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration — through *Marriage to Ame-no-Uzume*

After guiding Ninigi, Sarutahiko married Ame-no-Uzume.  Their union symbolized the alliance between heavenly and earthly powers and the role of humor and persuasion in resolving cosmic standoffs.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The kami who guides the great way; leadership as showing the path.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Travel, Tourism & Place Branding — through *Patron of Performers and Boundaries*

Sarutahiko's grotesque and powerful appearance made him a patron of street performers, comedians, and those who manage transitions.  His image appears at festival processions and at shrines dedicated to safe travel and guidance.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The kami who guides travelers at the crossroads; every journey begins with his leave.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Sarutahiko's mythology centers on the moment when the heavenly line met the earthly kami and found a guide rather than an enemy.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in communication, messaging & logistics, leadership, governance & public administration, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sarutahiko/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
